documentations-slot.name: GallerySlot

gallerySlot.name: gallerySlot
gallerySlot.description:
Defines the docking position of the slot inside the gallery grid.
- 'center' (default): slot floats over the main slider.

gallerySlotAlign.name: gallerySlotAlign
gallerySlotAlign.description: Controls cross-axis alignment within the selected area.

gallerySlotJustify.name: gallerySlotJustify
gallerySlotJustify.description: Controls main-axis justification within the selected area.
